description: This file contains implementation of quantization primitives, including functions and classes for per-channel int8 weight quantization, and modules for quantized linear layers and feedforward networks, specifically tailored for a model involving mixture of experts (MoE) with conditional feedforward components.

classes.name: WeightOnlyInt8QuantHandler
classes.description: Handles creation of quantized state dictionary and runtime conversion for models with weight-only int8 quantization.

classes.name: WeightOnlyInt8Linear
classes.description: A linear layer with weight and scale buffers for int8 quantization, supporting quantized forward pass.

classes.name: ConditionalFeedForwardInt8
classes.description: A conditional feedforward module with quantized weights and scales for multiple experts.

methods.name: dynamically_quantize_per_channel
methods.description: Performs symmetric per-channel quantization of a tensor to a specified dtype.

methods.name: replace_linear_weight_only_int8_per_channel
methods.description: Recursively replaces nn.Linear modules with quantized versions, excluding modules named 'gate'.

methods.name: create_quantized_state_dict
methods.description: Creates a state dict with quantized weights and scales for the model.

methods.name: convert_for_runtime
methods.description: Converts the model modules to runtime-optimized quantized versions.
